prose: Riley Ellison, Casey Morgan Ellison’s parent, requested a private psychoeducational evaluation to clarify learning and attention concerns that persist despite classroom supports. Presenting concerns include slow work completion and lost assignments. Riley Ellison hopes to obtain clear home and school recommendations to address these challenges. Areas of suspected disability evaluated include Specific Learning Disability and Other Health Impairment.
